d:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended a 'Diwali Milan' (Diwali gathering) event at the BJP headquarters in Delhi on Thursday. Addressing the journalists present, he remarked that nothing is considered impossible within a newsroom. Modi recalled, "I used to stay at 11 Ashoka Road. One day, some journalists suddenly walked into my room, playfully grabbed me by the neck, and demanded sweets. When I asked what the occasion was, they told me that I had become the Chief Minister of Gujarat. I wasn't even aware of it myself, yet the journalists already knew."
Production: Supriya
